architecture.text: Recent work tackles long-context attention limits and 3D consistency using HySparse2, GTR, and WorldCrafter, while optimizing agent scaffolds and hyperbolic residual quantization.

new-models.text: Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro, MintAct, and OmniVChat highlight a surge in efficient frontier models, unified vision agents, and native audio-visual dialogue systems across digital and physical domains.

inference-methods.text: Practitioners are scaling test-time compute through search policies, low-bit on-policy distillation, disaggregated quantization, and just-in-time state management to boost long-context inference and concurrency.
